people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
translations.bsb: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
translations.kjv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
translations.asv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning this matter.
